SELECT d.id, d.plan_id, p.plan_no, p.plan_type, p.planned_start_date, p.planned_end_date, p.plan_status, d.sales_order_id, d.sales_order_no, d.sales_order_detail_id, d.customer_id, d.customer_name, d.customer_code, d.product_id, d.product_code, pr.product_name, pr.product_spec, pr.product_color, d.allocated_qty, d.completed_qty, (d.allocated_qty - IFNULL(d.completed_qty, 0)) as remaining_qty, d.package_id, d.package_capacity, d.package_capacity_unit, pkg.material_name as package_name, pkg.description as package_spec, d.delivery_date, d.sales_remark, d.plan_remark FROM mis_production_plan_detail d INNER JOIN mis_production_plan p ON d.plan_id = p.id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mis_product pr ON d.product_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN mis_material pkg ON d.package_id = pkg.id WHERE p.plan_status = '1' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND (d.completed_qty IS NULL OR d.completed_qty < d.allocated_qty)
AND p.plan_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{planNo}, '%')
AND d.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
ORDER BY d.delivery_date ASC, d.create_time ASC
